about: What's new (⚙️ Settings): a few short lines per version, newest first. The full list of changes is CHANGELOG.md. Add the new version here when releasing.

versions.title: Characters
items: 👤 Several characters: each has its own class, quest ticks and Bag. Switch or add one from the chip at the top.
Planner: skill power for 20 more skills, with boxes for Gun AP, Throw AP and the weight you carry.
Stone Strike damage fixed. Fox starting stats checked in game.

versions.title: Planner, Bosses and Guardian
items: 🛠️ Planner: builds, status window, gear, buffs, Battle Summary against any monster.
👑 Bosses: trials, puzzles, drops and their quests.
🥚 Guardian: the 5 stages, graph recipes and skills.

versions.title: Tower group, Tick all, friends' Bags
items: Tick a whole chapter at once; see what's in your friends' Bags.

versions.title: Build guide
items: 🧭 Build guide: jobs, skills and the mastery cards they need.

versions.title: Episodes 3-6
items: Episodes 3-6, six new zones, the Monsters view and Share my Bag.

versions.title: Google sync and Friends
items: Sign in with Google to sync; add friends and see what they need.
